name: video-use
why: The most-starred editing skill in the ecosystem: choose-your-edit-by-conversation for talking heads, interviews, tutorials and montages. It encodes a production workflow (transcribe word-level, confirm the plan, cut, grade, animate overlays, burn subtitles, verify, persist state) rather than a menu of operations, which is the right interface for a person-on-camera edit.
caveats: Hosted transcription (ElevenLabs Scribe) is its default and needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY; no key is stored here, and local model downloads are blocked in this sandbox, so transcription steps are unavailable until a key or a local engine is provided.
Python deps are declared in pyproject.toml (uv sync / pip install -e .); the helpers still call plain ffmpeg for cut/render/grade, which is installed.
static/ (marketing images) was dropped from the vendored copy.
